senses.gloss: उपेक्षण n. 1. Leaving, abandoning; 2. over-looking, disregarding, neglecting; 3. indifference, contempt, R.xiv.65; 4. neglect considered as one of the seven expedients against an enemy. See उपाय.
उपेक्षा f. 1. Leaving, abandoning; 2. over-looking, disregarding, neglecting; 3. indifference, contempt, R.xiv.65; 4. neglect considered as one of the seven expedients against an enemy. See उपाय.
उपेत a. (f. ता) Possessed of, सर्वगुणोपेतम् (पुत्रम्) Sak.i., (pp. of इ with उप q.v.)
उपेत a. (f. ता) Possessed of, सर्वगुणोपेतम् (पुत्रम्) Sak.i., (pp. of इ with उप q.v.)

उपेंद्र m. Name of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa as the younger brother of Indra in his fifth or Vāmana incarnation, उपेंद्रवज्रादपि दारुणोसि Git.G.v. (where there is a pun on उपेंद्रवज्रा, that being the name of the metre in which the a śloka is written.)
उपेय a. (f. या) 1. To be effected by any means; 2. to be approached; 3. to be obtained.
उपेय a. (f. या) 1. To be effected by any means; 2. to be approached; 3. to be obtained.
